name: Combining information from different senses
gist: Merging information from images, sound, text, and other data sources so models understand situations from multiple angles at once.
explain: Images and text are two modalities, but the world has more. Video has images plus time and motion. Audio has sound. A self-driving car has cameras, lidar sensors that measure distance, radar, and microphones. A robot in a factory has vision and touch sensors. If you want a model that understands a scene the way a human does, it needs to digest all of these at once. The challenge is that each modality comes with its own representation: images are spatial (two dimensions plus color channels), audio is temporal (sound waves over time), text is discrete symbols in sequence, and sensor data from a lidar is a point cloud in three dimensions. Merging them is like translating between different languages and then finding the common meaning.

The difficulty is that modalities don't always agree, and they provide complementary information. In a video, you might see a person's mouth moving and hear speech. If they match, great — you have confirmed information. But if they don't match (the lips and sound are out of sync), that tells you something important — maybe the audio is dubbed or the video is corrupted. Audio alone tells you someone is speaking, but video tells you who and which direction they're facing. Text tells you what was said, but audio tells you the emotion and emphasis. A good multimodal model has to understand when modalities agree and learn from all of them, and when they conflict, understand why. This requires not just stacking separate encoders but building real fusion mechanisms.

Research in this space tackles multimodal fusion at different levels. Some work focuses on early fusion, where information from different modalities is combined before being processed deeply. Others use late fusion, where each modality is processed separately and then the results are combined. Still others build more intricate architectures where modalities can query and focus on each other — imagine the visual encoder asking the audio encoder 'what is the speaker saying?' and using that to interpret the visual content better. This cross-modal focusing works because each modality picks up details the others miss, so querying one fills in gaps in the other. Some work focuses on learning a shared representation where all modalities are projected into a common space, the way image-text models work, but extended to three or more modalities. The goal is to build models that can take a video with sound and text captions and understand the event as a unified whole, not as separate streams of data.

papers.title: Dissecting Multimodal In-Context Learning: Modality Asymmetries and Circuit Dynamics in modern Transformers
papers.contribution: Provides mechanistic foundation showing multimodal ICL relies on induction circuits refined and extended across modalities, with fundamental asymmetries between modalities.

papers.title: LIMSSR: LLM-Driven Sequence-to-Score Reasoning under Training-Time Incomplete Multimodal Observations
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on Action Quality Assessment datasets without complete training data.

papers.title: MER-DG: Modality-Entropy Regularization for Multimodal Domain Generalization
papers.contribution: Improves average performance by ~5% over standard fusion and ~2% over state-of-the-art on EPIC-Kitchens and HAC benchmarks.

papers.title: MultiLoReFT: Decoupling Shared and Modality-Specific Subspaces in Multimodal Learning via Low-Rank Representation Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: Produces multimodal representations supporting prediction while explicitly revealing distributed shared and modality-specific information across modalities on simulated and real-world benchmarks.

papers.title: Music Flamingo: Scaling Music Understanding in Audio Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on 10+ music understanding benchmarks, establishing Music Flamingo as a generalist audio-language model for advanced music reasoning.

papers.title: Stable Spectral Copula Alignment for Robust Multimodal Learning
papers.contribution: Improves robustness under perturbations and monotone distortions with reduced degradation compared to standard approaches; provides label-free, actionable diagnostic signals.

papers.title: Text-Driven Fusion for Infrared and Visible Images: Achieving Image Scene Adaptation on Hyperbolic Space
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art fusion approaches on benchmark datasets with autonomous content-aware adaptation at inference time without requiring textual input.

papers.title: VowelPrompt: Hearing Speech Emotions from Text via Vowel-level Prosodic Augmentation
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under zero-shot, fine-tuned, and cross-domain scenarios.

papers.title: AVERE: Improving Audiovisual Emotion Reasoning with Preference Optimization
papers.contribution: AVEm-DPO improves baseline performance by 6-19% relative in zero-shot emotion reasoning on DFEW, RAVDESS, and EMER datasets.

papers.title: Bioacoustic Geolocation: Species Sounds as Geographic Signals
papers.contribution: Results highlight the potential of incorporating bioacoustic signals into geospatial tasks.

papers.title: Closing the Modality Gap Aligns Group-Wise Semantics
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that reducing the modality gap provides marginal improvements for instance-wise tasks but significantly enhances group-wise tasks like clustering.

papers.title: Dynamic Reflections: Probing Video Representations with Text Alignment
papers.contribution: Shows alignment depends on richness of visual and text data provided at test time, and strong alignment correlates with general-purpose video representation and temporal reasoning.

papers.title: ERAlign: Energy-based Representation Alignment of GNNs and LLMs on Text-attributed Graphs
papers.contribution: Obtains state-of-the-art performance on TAG datasets with energy-discrepancy training enabling higher efficiency and reduced landscape distortion.

papers.title: Geometry-based Schrödinger Bridges for Trustworthy Multimodal Fusion
papers.contribution: GMF significantly improves robustness against severe sensor noise and semantic conflicts by flagging unreliable inputs independently of classifier confidence.

papers.title: Group Cognition Learning: Making Everything Better Through Controlled Two-Stage Agents Collaboration
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art results on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and MIntRec benchmarks while mitigating modality dominance and spurious coupling across both regression and classification tasks.

papers.title: IBMA: Information Bottleneck-Based Multimodal Alignment
papers.contribution: Achieves superior multimodal learning performance compared to existing methods, validating the effectiveness of modality-specific representation alignment.

papers.title: Image is All You Need: Towards Efficient and Effective Large Language Model-Based Recommender Systems
papers.contribution: The method outperforms description-based approaches in both efficiency and effectiveness on Amazon datasets while reducing sensitivity to noisy descriptions.

papers.title: Interactive Person Retrieval via Multi-Turn Multimodal Conversation
papers.contribution: Achieves substantial improvements in retrieval accuracy and generalization; code and dataset publicly available at github.com/Flame-Chasers/MNEMO.

papers.title: LLaVA-4D: Embedding SpatioTemporal Prompt into LMMs for 4D Scene Understanding
papers.contribution: LLaVA-4D enables 4D scene understanding distinguishing static backgrounds from dynamic objects; demonstrates superiority on various 4D reasoning tasks.

papers.title: LMM4-IC4K: A Large Multimodal Model Powered Integrated Circuit Footprint Geometry Understanding
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art LMMs on footprint labeling, advancing automation and standardization in PCB design with 8,608 labeled training samples.

papers.title: MetaStreet: Semi-Supervised Multimodal Learning for Street-Level Socioeconomic Prediction
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on two cities across three socioeconomic prediction tasks leveraging spatial autocorrelation.

papers.title: Modeling Long-Tail Relations in the Operating Room via In-Context Multimodal Learning
papers.contribution: Improves accuracy on long-tail categories by 6.9% while achieving 2.6% overall accuracy improvement.

papers.title: Multimodal Fusion via Self-Consistent Task-Gradient Fields
papers.contribution: SCFAE handles missing data and unequal input sizes more robustly than alternatives; gradient analysis confirms it avoids conflicts and maintains stable training dynamics.

papers.title: Multimodal Nested Learning for Decoupled and Coordinated Optimization
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superiority on eight datasets across three tasks through decoupled and coordinated multimodal learning.

papers.title: Omni-Captioner: Data Pipeline, Models, and Benchmark for Omni Detailed Perception
papers.contribution: Omni-Captioner achieves state-of-the-art on VDC and best detail-hallucination tradeoff on video-SALMONN 2, with performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro.

papers.title: OmniShow: Unifying Multimodal Conditions for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across various multimodal conditioning settings and establishes HOIVG-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for the task.

papers.title: OmniVideo-R1: Reinforcing Audio-visual Reasoning with Query Intention and Modality Attention
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms strong baselines on multiple benchmarks with robust generalization to mixed-modality reasoning.

papers.title: Resp-Agent: An Agent-Based System for Multimodal Respiratory Sound Generation and Disease Diagnosis
papers.contribution: Introduces Resp-229k benchmark (229k recordings); consistently outperforms prior approaches under data scarcity and long-tailed class imbalance.

papers.title: Scalable Medical Multimodal Fusion via Symmetric Consistency Modeling
papers.contribution: Demonstrates effectiveness and scalability on five multimodal medical datasets while supporting arbitrary modality numbers and reducing noise via structured mutual verification.

papers.title: Scalable Multilingual Multimodal Machine Translation with Speech-Text Fusion
papers.contribution: SMMT achieves state-of-the-art on Multi30K and new state-of-the-art average performance on FLORES-200 across 108 translation directions.

papers.title: SiMO: Single-Modality-Operable Multimodal Collaborative Perception
papers.contribution: Enables systems to maintain optimal performance across all individual modalities even when specific sensors fail, addressing modality competition issues.

papers.title: Toward Structural Multimodal Representations: Specialization, Selection, and Sparsification via Mixture-of-Experts
papers.contribution: Improves accuracy on MultiBench benchmarks with consistent sparsity-performance dynamics exhibiting reverse U-shaped trend with peak at intermediate sparsity.

papers.title: Towards Uniformity and Alignment for Multimodal Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that the proposed method acts as an efficient proxy for a global Hölder divergence over multiple modality distributions, reducing distribution gaps, with consistent gains on retrieval and generation tasks.

papers.title: Understanding Multimodal Learning: A Loss Landscape Smoothness Perspective
papers.contribution: Shows multimodal models achieve smoother loss landscapes with better robustness and generalization; stochastic pairing further promotes flatness.

papers.title: UrbanFusion: Stochastic Multimodal Fusion for Contrastive Learning of Robust Spatial Representations
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art GeoAI models on 41 tasks across 56 cities, generalizes to unseen regions, and flexibly utilizes any subset of available modalities at inference.

papers.title: video-SALMONN S: Memory-Enhanced Streaming Audio-Visual LLM
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms streaming and non-streaming baselines by 3-7% on long video benchmarks and achieves 15% absolute accuracy improvement on episodic learning tasks.
